Look at the image below. In 25 seconds, please speak into the microphone and describe in detail what the image is showing. You will have 40 seconds to give your response.
ITEM IMAGE
EXAMPLE ANSWER
This
line
graph
from
Statistics
Canada
shows
population
growth
trends
from
1972
to
2002
,
measured
in
thousands
.
Net
international
migration
,
shown
in
green
,
is
consistently
the
highest
line
.
It
peaked
at
around
500
thousand
in
1982
,
dipped
to
250
thousand
by
1992
,
then
recovered
to
400
thousand
by
2002
.
Total
growth
in
black
follows
a
similar
pattern
at
a
lower
level
,
rising
from
100
to
300
thousand
,
falling
to
150
,
then
climbing
to
250
thousand
.
Natural
increase
in
blue
is
the
most
stable
,
gradually
declining
from
200
to
150
thousand
.
Notably
,
total
growth
closely
mirrors
the
fluctuations
of
net
migration
,
indicating
that
immigration
was
the
primary
driver
of
Canada's
population
increase
during
this
period
.
